# History rewrite 2026-09-20 — old → new commit map

Before the first push to GitHub, `git filter-repo --replace-text` replaced the dead single-use bootstrap enrolment token that commit c7846dc had committed into docs/evidence/phase-0/wp0.2-summary.md (Phase 0 gate finding P0-10; the token was minted against a scratch database that was dropped, never redeemed, and authenticated nothing). Every commit from c7846dc onward was rewritten, so every SHA cited in docs/plan/01-execution-log.md and the evidence docs before this date refers to the OLD hash. This table maps them. A pre-rewrite bundle is kept outside the repo at ~/backups/.
